# MODELS AND NODES USED IN THIS WORKFLOW  

---

### Put all models in the models folder, organized into their respective subfolders. 
### If a required folder doesn’t exist, create it.

---

## 🟣 ONNX Detection Model Loader (3 Models)
### Download **vitpose_h_wholebody_model.onnx** from [HERE](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/vitpose_comfy/resolve/main/onnx/vitpose_h_wholebody_model.onnx)

### Download **vitpose_h_wholebody_data.bin** from [HERE](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/vitpose_comfy/resolve/main/onnx/vitpose_h_wholebody_data.bin)

### Download **yolov10m.onnx** from [HERE](https://huggingface.co/Wan-AI/Wan2.2-Animate-14B/resolve/main/process_checkpoint/det/yolov10m.onnx)


📁 **Place in:** `ComfyUI/models/detection` 

---

## 🟣 WanVideo Model Loader
### Download **Wan21-14B-SCAIL-preview_fp8_e4m3fn_scaled_KJ.safetensors** from [HERE](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/WanVideo_comfy_fp8_scaled/resolve/main/SCAIL/Wan21-14B-SCAIL-preview_fp8_e4m3fn_scaled_KJ.safetensors)

Or

📁 **Place in:** `ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/scail` 

---

## 🟣 WanVideo Lora Select
### Download **lightx2v_I2V_14B_480p_cfg_step_distill_rank64_bf16** from [HERE](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/WanVideo_comfy/resolve/main/Lightx2v/lightx2v_I2V_14B_480p_cfg_step_distill_rank64_bf16.safetensors)

## 🟣 WanVideo VAE Loader

📁 **Place in:** `ComfyUI/models/vae` 

---

## 🟣 Load CLIP Vision
### Download **clip_vision_h.safetensors** from [HERE](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Wan_2.1_ComfyUI_repackaged/resolve/main/split_files/clip_vision/clip_vision_h.safetensors)
